# 12 Acre Films

> 12 Acre Films is a Spokane, Washington video production company (founded 2016 by Matt Slotemaker) specializing in commercial, documentary, live event, and social media video, plus live streaming of events and funerals across the Inland Northwest.

## Services
- [All services](https://www.12acrefilms.com/services)
- [Live stream & live event video production](https://www.12acrefilms.com/live-events): multi-camera live streaming, event videography, recording
- [Funeral live streaming & recording](https://www.12acrefilms.com/funeral-live-streaming): private live streams and recordings of funerals, memorials, and celebrations of life
- [Teleprompter operator](https://www.12acrefilms.com/teleprompter-operator): operator with a 17-inch two-way mirror prompter and presidential prompter experience, for corporate videos, speeches, commercials and live events
- [TV & web commercial production](https://www.12acrefilms.com/tv-commercial-production): 15/30/60-second spots for broadcast, streaming and online
- [Radio commercial & audio ad production](https://www.12acrefilms.com/radio-commercial-production): scripting, voiceover and mixing for radio and audio ads
- [Podcast production & recording](https://www.12acrefilms.com/podcast-video-recording): video and audio podcasts, editing and clips
- [Commercial & corporate video production](https://www.12acrefilms.com/corporate-video-production): brand, marketing, training and explainer video
- [Nonprofit & fundraising video](https://www.12acrefilms.com/nonprofit-fundraising-video): capital campaigns, galas and impact stories
- [Interview & testimonial video](https://www.12acrefilms.com/interview-testimonial-video): documentary-style interviews and customer testimonials
- [Social media video content](https://www.12acrefilms.com/social-media-video): short-form video for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube
- [Aerial drone video & photography](https://www.12acrefilms.com/aerial-drone-video): licensed and insured aerial video and photos for businesses, properties, events
- [Archival media digitization](https://www.12acrefilms.com/archival-media-digitization): VHS, photo prints, slides, 35mm and medium format film, DVD and CD to digital
- [VHS to digital](https://www.12acrefilms.com/vhs-to-digital): home video tape transfer
- [U-matic 3/4-inch tape to digital](https://www.12acrefilms.com/umatic-to-digital): professional videotape transfer
- [Photo scanning](https://www.12acrefilms.com/photo-scanning): prints and albums
- [Film slide scanning](https://www.12acrefilms.com/film-slide-scanning): 35mm slides and trays
- [35mm film scanning](https://www.12acrefilms.com/35mm-film-scanning): negatives and strips
- [Medium format film scanning](https://www.12acrefilms.com/medium-format-film-scanning): 120 roll film
- [DVD & CD transfer](https://www.12acrefilms.com/dvd-cd-transfer): home-burned discs
- [Video gear rental](https://www.12acrefilms.com/gear-rental): cameras, lenses, lighting, grip and audio
- [Video for small business](https://www.12acrefilms.com/for/small-business)
- [Video for startups](https://www.12acrefilms.com/for/startups)
- [Video for nonprofits](https://www.12acrefilms.com/for/nonprofits)
- [Portfolio](https://www.12acrefilms.com/work)
- [Documentary](https://www.12acrefilms.com/documentary)
- [Gear list](https://www.12acrefilms.com/gear-list)
